seo.title: A Clear Google Presence Score per Branch | SAAYT
seo.description: One score per branch built from profile completeness · review response time and hours accuracy so you can compare branches at a glance

h1: One score that shows where every branch stands
lead: A score out of 100 for each branch combining profile completeness, reply speed and hours accuracy so you know who needs support and who deserves thanks

items.d: The same criteria for every branch in every city
A number with a clear reason instead of impressions
Track each branch week after week
Average time to reply to reviews
Every point has a written reason and the method is visible
Highest to lowest with city filters

steps.d: The score updates after the fix

guard.d: The score is an internal readiness measure. It does not represent your position in Google results and we never promise rankings

faq.q: Will the score raise my Google ranking?
faq.a: We never promise rankings. The score measures things you control such as completeness and reply speed
The weights are shown clearly and we review them with you based on your priorities
The score focuses on what you control and shows the average rating beside it for context
